functional_source_assessment.scope: Exact four-source candidate; admission, time/deadline, pins, strict JSON, journal identity/accounting/append, child process-group cleanup and postcondition checks; interpreter startup and source paths; stdin; preservation of script arguments.
functional_source_assessment.assessment: The reviewed implementation meets the accepted program-input and remaining-argument repair contracts. Python requires isolated and no-site startup; Bash requires privileged mode; selected scripts are directly pinned regular files; child stdin is DEVNULL; literal arguments after the script remain ordinary arguments; existing path checks now cover those arguments, including special files. The prior v3 empty-slice defect is fixed by checking argv[script_index + 1:]. Existing admission and bounded-execution checks reviewed against the candidate remain consistent with the accepted source scope and docs.

findings.property: Constitution VII requires genuine behavioral failing evidence before AI implementation; Constitution VIII makes unresolved mandatory evidence blocking. The accepted plan explicitly preserves the earlier historical gaps and forbids retrospective evidence from satisfying them.
findings.evidence: The inspected prior exact-source review source-astra-v3.json records the original valid-policy driver baseline as missing and the required v2 pre-edit behavioral RED as not established; the retained original evidence used a missing/disabled policy baseline, a pre-v2 AttributeError/setup failure, and later valid-policy replay. The accepted program-input-repair-plan-v2.md says these gaps remain unmet and cannot be repaired by this work. Current input-program-red-evidence-v3.json, input-root-identical-green-v1.json, input-v3-fifo-split-red-evidence.json and input-green-evidence-v4.json demonstrate later scoped source fixes only.
